730:t_10:14.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Besides, he wants to pay the $$御使い$$s back more than anyone. He'll wake up for sure.」

730:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Please hurry, $n... Your battle, and humanity's, is about to reach its end...)

730:t_10:22.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I hear his condition is similar to $$刹那$$'s back with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$. An enormous strain was put on his brain cells, and as a result he has lost consciousness.」

730:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「He took in the will of everyone in $c, so it's no wonder...」

730:t_10:24.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Why did $n do something like that...」

730:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You must know it too, Miss $$スズネ$$. $n and $$アサキム$$ are no different: neither cares what means they use, so long as it serves their goal.」

730:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If it's necessary, $n would even give up his own life.」

730:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The battle that is about to begin...」

730:t_10:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It is the final one, and for $n, it is the fight against the enemy he has been chasing ever since the day he boarded $$ジェニオン$$.」

731:t_000:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「We have arrived at 150 degrees east longitude on the equator. All units have finished launching.」

731:t_000:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「So this is $$エス・テラン$$... The Earth of the $$カオス・コスモス$$...」

731:t_000:2.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Because the gravity is weak, the atmosphere is thin too. You could say the high altitudes are no different from outer space.」

731:t_000:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Incidentally, the structure of this world is no different from the $$カオス・コスモス$$. This is an anything-goes space too.」

731:t_000:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「In short, we can use $$天元突破グレンラガン#robot$$ and $$ダイバスター$$ even on this planet, right?」

731:t_000:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「Hasn't the one who matters most, $$アサキム$$, shown up yet...?」

731:t_000:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「By the way, on our Earth this spot is where $$リモネシア$$ used to be.」

731:t_000:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「The place where the $$カラミティ・バース$$ happened, huh...」

731:t_000:8.en:
$$トライア$$
「This is a location that has an important meaning on Earth's ley lines. Maybe that's why it's a special place in every parallel world as well.」

731:t_000:9.en:
$$トライア$$
「In the $$ＡＤＷ$$, it's $$リモネシア$$, the largest producer of $$ＤＥＣ$$... In the world the $$フロンティア船団$$ came from, it's Mayan Island... And...」

731:t_000:10.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「In $$インサラウム$$, it's where the Holy City stood.」

731:t_000:11.en:
$$エスター$$
「So that's why $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ was set up...」

731:t_000:12.en:
$$トライア$$
「Earth is the ideal place to gather dimensional force, and the force gathered there nourishes Earth itself...」

731:t_000:13.en:
$$トライア$$
「I'd guess the $$御使い$$s used that power to build that system they call $$至高神ソル$$.」

731:t_002:1.en:
$$シン$$
「You're the one who summoned us, and you show up late? Who do you think you are!」

731:t_002:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Wait, $$シン$$. Let's talk to him first.」

731:t_002:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Yo, $$アサキム$$... What did you mean just now by 'that's exactly right'?」

731:t_002:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「The sight of this land... It's about the remark that it looks like a grave.」

731:t_002:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「This is $$サクリファイ$$'s Garden... A place of mourning, for grieving the countless lives the $$御使い$$s have taken.」

731:t_002:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「Why did you choose this place for our decisive battle?」

731:t_002:8.en:
$$アサキム$$
「On this lifeless planet, this is the only place that lets me feel death...」

731:t_002:9.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I only thought it fitting for the end of things between us.」

731:t_002:11.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You... Do you even want to talk to us!」

731:t_002:12.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I answered because you asked. I'd like you to consider that rare for me.」

731:t_002:13.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Indeed. I never imagined I could hold a conversation with you, who always just says whatever you please.」

731:t_002:14.en:
$$桂$$
「So even you get a little melancholy before the decisive battle, huh?」

731:t_002:15.en:
$$アサキム$$
「It's meaningless to measure me by the yardstick of your emotions.」

731:t_002:16.en:
$$エスター$$
(Every single thing he says is infuriating!)

731:t_002:17.en:
$$宗介$$
(Is he trying to provoke us?)

731:t_002:18.en:
$$クロウ$$
(Hold it in. Leave this to $$ランド$$ and $$セツコ$$ for now.)

731:t_002:19.en:
$$ランド$$
「Hey, $$アサキム$$... You really have to go through with this?」

731:t_002:20.en:
$$セツコ$$
「If fighting the $$御使い$$s is your goal, we could even join forces...」

731:t_002:21.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Is that really all right with you, $$セツコ$$? Can you forgive me, the man who took the lives of the people dear to you?」

731:t_002:22.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Your fallen comrades would grieve even more than you, if you said you forgive me.」

731:t_002:24.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$アサキム$$! What kind of man are you!」

731:t_002:25.en:
$$勝平$$
「Is it that much fun to make Sis $$セツコ$$ suffer like this!?」

731:t_002:26.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$アサキム$$...! Is what you just said your answer!?」

731:t_002:27.en:
$$アサキム$$
「To defeat the $$御使い$$s, the power of the $$スフィア$$s is necessary.」

731:t_002:28.en:
$$アサキム$$
「The four I hold and the four you hold... Only with all eight $$スフィア$$s can one finally fight them on even terms.」

731:t_002:29.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Then, if we combine our strength...」

731:t_002:30.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I told you: you cannot defeat the $$御使い$$s.」

731:t_002:32.en:
$$アサキム$$
「With you, I can already see the ending where they seize your $$スフィア$$s. So I'll be the one to hunt them first.」

731:t_002:33.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「If you got hold of the $$スフィア$$s, would you defeat the $$御使い$$s and stop the great collapse of the universe?」

731:t_002:34.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I have no interest in that. Let what is doomed to perish, perish.」

731:t_002:36.en:
$$アルト$$
「Just because you're immortal, you don't care at all that other lives are disappearing!?」

731:t_002:38.en:
$n
「That self-righteousness... You're the same as the $$御使い$$s!」

731:t_002:39.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I can't accept those words.」

731:t_002:40.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You got angry, huh... Even you couldn't stand being seen as the same as your own enemy, it seems.」

731:t_002:41.en:
$$ランド$$
「Hey, $$アサキム$$... Is the reason you fight them that they gave you an immortal body?」

731:t_002:43.en:
$$ランド$$
「What in the world did they do that for, anyway?」

731:t_002:44.en:
$$アサキム$$
「...It's because I had the power to detect the shattered fragments of $$太極$$... the $$スフィア$$s.」

731:t_002:45.en:
$$赤木$$
「Why do you have a power like that?」

731:t_002:46.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Who knows... But by the time I noticed, I was bound to them with chains of causality...」
